item.title: Accel raises $5B to back late-stage bets
item.description: Accel announced on Tuesday that it raised $5 billion in fresh capital to back late-stage companies building AI.

item.title: Stanford report highlights growing disconnect between AI insiders and everyone else
item.description: Stanford’s latest AI Index shows a widening gap between experts and the public, with rising anxiety over jobs, healthcare, and the economy.

item.title: At the HumanX conference, everyone was talking about Claude
item.description: Anthropic was the star of the show at San Francisco's AI-centric conference.

item.title: Florida AG announces investigation into OpenAI over shooting that allegedly involved ChatGPT
item.description: ChatGPT had reportedly been used to plan the attack that killed two and injured five at Florida State University last April. The family of one victim has said that they plan to sue OpenAI over the incident.

item.title: Anthropic debuts preview of powerful new AI model Mythos in new cybersecurity initiative
item.description: The new model will be used by a small number of high-profile companies to engage in defensive cybersecurity work.

item.title: Google Translate’s real-time headphone translations feature expands to iOS and more countries
item.description: The real-time headphone translations experience keeps each speaker’s tone, emphasis, and cadence intact, so it’s easier to follow the conversation and tell who’s saying what.

item.title: Google is launching Search Live globally
item.description: Search Live allows users to point their phone camera at objects to get real-time assistance, enabling back-and-forth conversations that draw on the visual context from the camera feed.

item.title: WhatsApp can now draft AI-generated responses based on your conversations
item.description: The Meta-owned messaging platform is also launching a way to free up space, the ability to touch up photos with Meta AI, and more.

item.title: After pivoting, Y Combinator grad Glimpse raises $35M led by a16z
item.description: Glimpse announced on Wednesday a $35 million Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz, with participation from 8VC and YC.

item.title: Snapchat’s new ‘AI Clips’ Lens format turns photos into five-second videos
item.description: Snapchat says both experienced and new developers can use the new "AI Clips" Lens format to turn a single prompt into a published Lens in minutes without the need for external tools.

item.title: AI startups are eating the venture industry and the returns, so far, are good
item.description: AI startups accounted for 41% of the $128 billion in venture dollars raised by companies on Carta last year — a record-high annual share.

item.title: Employees had to restrain a dancing humanoid robot after it went wild at a California restaurant
item.description: A dancing robot in a Haidilao hot pot restaurant boogied down a little too hard.

item.title: Breakout Ventures raises $114M fund to back AI science startups
item.description: Breakout Ventures is finding growing success by backing early-stage startups in scientific fields such as biology and chemistry.

item.title: Amazon expands a program that lets customers shop from other retailers’ sites
item.description: The changes allow more merchants to participate in Amazon's Shop Direct program, which sends Amazon customers to other retailers' websites.

item.title: AI network startup Eridu emerges from stealth with hefty $200M Series A
item.description: Unlike a vibe-coded product built by a college dropout, Eridu's co-founder, Drew Perkins, has been inventing networking tech since the dawn of the internet.

item.title: Wearable startup CUDIS launches a new health ring line with an AI-fueled ‘coach’
item.description: The wearable incentivizes healthy behavior with points that can be redeemed for health products.

item.title: Gemini can now automate some multi-step tasks on Android
item.description: Gemini on Android will be able to automate tasks involving rideshare requests, or grocery or food delivery, says Google.

item.title: Amazon’s AI-powered Alexa+ gets new personality options
item.description: Users will be able to choose from Alexa styles like Brief, Chill, or Sweet, Amazon says.

item.title: Uber engineers built an AI version of their boss
item.description: Uber CEO Dara Khosrowshahi said the company’s employees have gone all in on AI, going so far as to build a chatbot of him that they use to practice their pitches.
